attempts.note: The only API docs (linked from OpenFn/adaptors#773) are in a private Postman workspace: 401/403 without a team login.
No public Mojatax workspace or collection; only stray requests to engage.mojatax.com (a different SMS product).
vfd-staging, vfd and vfd-sandbox.mojatax.com time out or do not resolve publicly; /swagger, /api-docs, /api/docs, /docs-json, /v3/api-docs, /openapi.json untested beyond connection failure.

api.mojatax.com is a NestJS app (GET /api returns a timestamp); /api/docs, /api-json, /api/docs-json, /swagger, /docs-json, /api-docs all 404, and POST /api/v1/auth/clientLogin is not routed there (it is a different service from the VFD API).
Marketing WordPress site; sitemap has no developer or API pages.
No vendor org or SDK; the only non-OpenFn hit (Mideny21/mojatax) is a UI-only Flutter mock with no API calls.

notes: Mojatax is a Tanzanian VFD (virtual fiscal device) service that registers invoices with TRA; its API is private and documented only in a non-public Postman workspace, and its VFD hosts are not reachable from outside. The adaptor logs in with POST /api/v1/auth/clientLogin {client_id,password} -> {access_token} and exposes generic post(path) (prefixed /api/v1/client/) and request(method, path) (prefixed /api/v1); the only documented business route is POST /api/v1/client/CreateInvoice. 'Full' therefore means every route evidenced by the adaptor source, tests, README and request issue: 2 operations. The July 2026 stub had the wrong paths (/client/GetToken, /client/CreateInvoice without the /api/v1 prefix) and an invented CancelInvoice route; both are fixed or removed. Invoice item and receipt fields are not public, so the schemas carry only the fields OpenFn's examples show and allow additional properties.
